libOverrides.source-kit.mjs: (1) all components are default exports; synth-entry's `export * from` never forwards a default binding, so fork adds an aliased `export { default as Name }` per file. (2) componentSrcMap:null now also drops the file from the synth entry (not just the discovered name) so next/link's top-level process.env reads (Sidebar/MobileNav/AppShell) can't crash the whole shared IIFE
